similar_in_english: a man's home is his castle
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার খাসমহলে সবাইকে আমন্ত্রণ জানানো হয়েছে।
এটি আমার খাসমহল, এখানে আমি রাজা।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone is invited to his khasmohol.
This is my khasmohol; here I am the king.
history: In the historical zamindari system of Bengal, 'khasmahal' referred to the private estate and personal residence of the zamindar or ruler, exempt from certain taxes and under direct control.
note: This term originates from Persian influences in Mughal and colonial-era Bengal administration.
